capabilities.summary: Resolve a provider/model reference through the owning product credential store. The native result includes an API key; adapters must keep it private. Hub preview never resolves credentials or invokes this function.

models.resolve.input: Native JSDoc: model ref and options with injected CredentialStore and trusted tenantId
models.resolve.formatNote: JSDoc reference only; no JSON Schema or TypeScript declaration is claimed.
models.resolve.projection: Any future public adapter must omit apiKey and bind tenant identity outside invocation JSON.

manef:boundaries: Portable library identity and tenant binding belong to the embedding host; web auth and encrypted Convex credentials remain product-owned.
Resolution is offline by default; an adapter enabling info:true may fetch catalog metadata and must declare that separate network behavior.

manef:runtime-notes.checks: Security module-mock tests use Node experimental flags; minimum library runtime is distinct from the tested toolchain.
